$comment: Generated from packages/ui/tokens by `npm run tokens:build`. Do not edit: change the tokens and rebuild.

modifiers.name: colorScheme
modifiers.description: Light is the base set; dark overrides the colors and state layers it changes. Theme writes the scheme to data-env-theme.

modifiers.name: contrast
modifiers.description: Reserved for the high-contrast themes. Neither context overrides anything yet, so high equals standard and no CSS is built for it.

modifiers.name: scale
modifiers.description: Reserved for the app scale. Neither context overrides anything yet, so compact equals comfortable and no CSS is built for it.

tokens.description: The envsemble avatar: the default person picture and initials share it in both themes.
Calendars: the chosen day is a solid blue circle with white text (4.5:1), today a blue ring.

dark.description: The chosen day is the light blue of a chosen radio, with dark text, so the circle stands out from dark popups and panes (3:1); today keeps the ring in the same blue.

tokens.description: Dialogs and the command palette: the popup surface, which in the dark theme stays the pane color so rows and fields inside keep their contrast.
Rows on a menu pane: white in light, raised from the pane in dark.
Initials use a deeper shade of the figure blue: 5:1 on the avatar fill.
Labels on action and navigation fills keep 4.5:1 on their hover shades too, also on a tab rail: outlined and selected navigation labels are a deeper blue than links.

dark.description: As bright as primary text: a selected secondary tab's hover fill sits on the rail's fill.

tokens.description: Popups raised over the page, such as the open list of a Select.

dark.description: The primary action takes the same soft blue as links, with dark text, so the dark theme carries the same blue emphasis as the light one without a saturated fill. It is its own value, so the two roles stay independent.

tokens.description: The content color that fills and state layers mix with transparency, in TokensHandwritten.css.
Completed work, such as a merged or closed-as-done item.
Text in rows keeps clear of the large outer corners, whether a row stands alone or is connected.
A window title bar drawn by the application, which keeps compact controls.
